title: Start Step 1: Minimal multi-endpoint market-data fetcher scaffold + deploy fix

requirements.text: Perform a clean rebuild (frontend + backend) and identify the exact cause of the canister deployment failure, capturing the precise failing step and error details (e.g., Motoko compile error, missing import/module, Candid/interface mismatch, wasm size/limit).
acceptanceCriteria: A single, concrete root cause is documented (not a hypothesis), including the file and symbol/line area implicated when applicable
The project builds successfully locally in the build pipeline after the fix in REQ-4 is applied
If the failure is due to Candid mismatch, the generated frontend declarations align with the backend interface after rebuild

requirements.text: Implement Step 1 of the multi-endpoint integration plan in the backend by adding a clean, minimal fetcher structure that supports multiple external market-data HTTP endpoints, without implementing dataset merging, stable caching, background refresh loops, or last-good fallback logic yet.
acceptanceCriteria: All Motoko changes remain within the single actor in backend/main.mo (no new backend services)
The backend compiles and the canister deploys successfully after this step
There is a clear internal abstraction for multiple endpoints (e.g., an endpoint registry/list + per-endpoint fetch function signatures) even if only minimal responses are returned
No stable cache or timer-based refresh is introduced in this step

requirements.text: Expose a minimal backend public API suitable for validating Step 1 at runtime: a method to trigger fetching from a selected endpoint and return a small, typed result (or a typed error) so endpoint connectivity/response parsing can be verified independently before any merging/caching is added.
acceptanceCriteria: A frontend-independent call path exists to fetch a single endpoint (by an explicit selector/variant) and return a result that can be inspected
Errors are handled deterministically (no traps for routine HTTP/parse failures) and returned in a structured way
The method is authorized appropriately (consistent with existing access control patterns) or explicitly documented as non-sensitive if left public

constraints: Respect single-actor backend architecture: keep all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo.
Do not introduce unsupported backend technologies or external databases/services beyond verified HTTP calls.

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Do not implement Step 2+ (individual endpoint implementations per market, merging, stable caching, 2-minute background refresh, last-good fallback, FX/base-currency handling) in this build request.
Do not add or change dashboard analytics, allocation charts, or UI modernization in this step unless required to fix a Candid/build break.
